paper.title: Methods for Heart Rate Variability Biofeedback (HRVB): A Systematic Review and Guidelines
paper.claim: Implements a generated, descriptive, protocol-matched summary of heart-rate dynamics during Brainstem guided-breathing sessions.
paper.population: The systematic review and its included populations do not validate a Brainstem device; this package contains generated participants only.
paper.referenceStandard: Published reporting guidance plus a deterministic participant-grouped generated R-R fixture.
paper.relationEvidence: The package applies the review's reproducibility requirement by binding the complete pace and phase tuple, then independently recomputes bounded time-domain measures from generated R-R intervals.

classification.unit: eligible guided-breathing session under one exact protocol tuple

compatibility.brainstemContract: historical exercise plus finite rateCPM/ih/ip/eh/ep and raw R-R; protected contract proposed separately
compatibility.window: Use the complete accepted guided-breathing session and compare only recordings with the exact same pace and phase tuple.
compatibility.preprocessing: Reject generic exercise, missing or non-finite protocol fields, inconsistent pace/phase timing, implausible intervals, short sessions, and mixed protocols; recompute mean heart rate, RMSSD, and SD1; aggregate each participant once.
mismatches: Brainstem stores the prescribed pacing protocol but does not measure breathing adherence or respiratory volume.
The generated package does not validate sensor placement, detector error, a clinical population, or a normal range.
Uploaded averageHR, rsa, lnLF, and sf are deliberately ignored rather than treated as canonical measures.

cohort.output: Participant-equal aggregate quartiles for one exact guided-breathing protocol; no subject, recording, raw R-R, respiratory-adherence, or diagnostic rows.

personal.output: Owner-only matched-session summaries and latest-minus-earliest change across up to seven eligible guided-breathing sessions.
